description: The user's articles on UpFork (drafts, in review, published, hidden) and the products they may write about, one row each, without their text: get_my_article reads one whole. A developer with a public page writes about their own products. Read article_guide before writing one. Needs the user signed in, with the "articles" permission.
name: my_articles

outputSchema.description: The user's articles, and what they may write about.

approved.description: How many of their articles UpFork approved.

articles.description: Their articles, the latest saved first.

items.description: One of the user's articles, on their list.

changes.description: A published article with saved changes readers don't see yet: publish_article sends them out.

editorUrl.description: Where the user edits it on upfork.dev.

hiddenReason.description: Why UpFork hid it, when it did: the first 160 characters, get_my_article has it whole.

id.description: Give it as article to the other tools.

live.description: Whether readers can read a version of it.

off.description: The user took it off the site: only they see it until hide_article puts it back.

product.description: The product it's about, by slug.

reviewNote.description: What UpFork's reviewer asked to change, when it was sent back: the first 160 characters, get_my_article has it whole.

state.description: draft, in_review (waiting for UpFork's review), published or hidden (by UpFork).

products.description: The products they may write about.

items.description: A product the user may write about.

kind.description: component, landing_page, fullstack, mobile, desktop or script.

slug.description: Give it to create_article as product.

tags.description: Its tags (an article starts with them).

trusted.description: Whether their articles publish at once (two approved); otherwise publish_article sends one to UpFork's review.

title: Your UpFork articles
